Just over a month after their historic win over India in the T20 format, Ireland have been humbled by the visiting Afghanistan side in this ODI series. It has been a tough initiation for new coach Gary Wilson

Stirling: Would've had a bat today. Just emphasized to the lads how important this game is. Three changes.

Pitch and conditions | Ed Joyce: It's a chilly overcast day. Same pitch we played on on Wednesday. Little bit of dampness in there, indicating there might be movement in the first 10-15 overs. Tinge of green on it.

With the series in the bag, Afghanistan have given Rashid a break. Onus on their seamers to make the new ball count after opting to bowl first under overcast skies and on a pitch with a tinge of green on it. Both teams have made three changes from the previous match. For Afghanistan, their former captain Shahidi is playing his 100th ODI.
